ItemID: NA; Title: Ring Spotlight Cam Battery HD Security Camera with Built Two-Way Talk and a Siren Alarm, Works with Alexa - Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Outdoor security fits my interests, but my recent Blink camera already covers that need, so I would skip it this time.

ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Blink setup, but I would wait until I need more indoor coverage before choosing a three-camera pack.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Voice control could complement my Fire TV devices, but I would choose the Echo Show for its screen this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose it as a small bedside display and to try viewing compatible security cameras alongside Alexa controls.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interests center on my home setup, and I have no pressing need for Alexa in the car.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ring Video Doorbell Pro – Upgraded, with added security features and a sleek design (existing doorbell wiring required); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Seeing visitors would be useful, but I would need to check my doorbell wiring before considering this model.
